title: WisMesh Tag from RAKwireless - Meshtastic compatible card sized node 868/915 Mhz
description: What is WisMesh Tag? The WisMesh Tag is your compact companion for location tracking and mesh messaging. Built for Meshtastic users who want something portable and reliable. It is a thin, IP66-rated GPS tracker with a 1000 mAh battery. Pre-flashed with Meshtastic firmware.
